summary: Iteration 6 testing complete - Admin Reseller Management Workspace. All 32 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified: 3 tabs (Catalog, Policy, Audit), reseller drawer with float/status/commission controls, Settings Hub Distribution group includes Resellers and Reseller policy.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/admin/resellers returns array with all required fields: id, email, name, status, business_name, country, reseller_code, commission_rate, kyc_verified, float_balance, clients_count, lifetime_commission, last_active_at, created_at
lifetime_commission correctly aggregates from wallet_transactions where kind in [commission_earned, markup_earned]
GET /api/admin/resellers/{id}/detail returns {reseller, wallet, clients[], commission_overrides[], recent_commission[]}

POST /api/admin/resellers/{id}/float with {amount, note} - credits (positive) or claws back (negative); writes wallet_transactions with kind admin_topup/admin_clawback; writes audit log; sends notification. Correctly rejects amount=0
PUT /api/admin/resellers/{id}/status with {status: active|suspended|inactive} - updates user.status; audits; notifies. Correctly rejects invalid status
GET /api/admin/resellers/commission-audit?days=30 returns {since, transactions[], by_reseller[], grand_total} aggregated correctly from commission_earned + markup_earned kinds

Reseller policy settings exist in system_settings (category=reseller): reseller.default_commission=0.15, reseller.kyc_required=true, reseller.min_float_topup=1000, reseller.max_sub_clients=500, reseller.allow_invite_clients=true
Frontend /admin/resellers loads with 3 tabs: Reseller catalog, Global policy, Commission audit
Catalog tab shows stats cards (Resellers count, Total float out, Clients served, Commission paid), search box, refresh button, and table
Reseller drawer opens on row click with: stats, Suspend/Reactivate toggle, Float adjust form, Default commission input, Override form with add/delete, Sub-clients table
Global policy tab shows reseller-category settings with appropriate editors (bool->select, number->input)
Commission audit tab shows days selector (7/30/90/365), stat cards, By reseller table sorted desc, Recent transactions table
Settings Hub Distribution group includes 'Resellers' (links to /admin/resellers) and 'Reseller policy' (shows inline settings)
seed_data_creation: Float adjustments (+100, -50, +10) made to demo reseller during testing; KE/sms and UG/sms commission overrides created and deleted
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 complete. Admin Reseller Management Workspace fully implemented. Key features: (1) GET /api/admin/resellers returns reseller catalog with stats; (2) GET /api/admin/resellers/{id}/detail returns full reseller info with wallet, clients, overrides; (3) POST /api/admin/resellers/{id}/float for credit/clawback; (4) PUT /api/admin/resellers/{id}/status for status changes; (5) GET /api/admin/resellers/commission-audit for commission ledger; (6) Reseller policy settings in system_settings category=reseller; (7) Frontend has 3-tab page with drawer for per-reseller management; (8) Settings Hub Distribution group includes Resellers and Reseller policy. Demo reseller has ~509,067 float credits and 4,029 lifetime commission earned.
